## Description

Bell with count opens an overlay listing in-app notifications (kind, title, time) with "Mark all read". P1 events: reminder failed, leave rebooking needed, licence expiring, access request, quarterly access review due. Browser/phone push (optional) uses the generic text only.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Notifications are scoped to the user's tenant/facility and role.
- [ ] **AC2.** Push or browser notifications never include patient names or results; content is "New update from {clinic}. Open Medvya to view." (test on payload).
- [ ] **AC3.** Mark all read and per-item read state persist across devices.
- [ ] **AC4.** Overlay is keyboard accessible and screen-reader friendly.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
